scope: Compare units and decimal precision on the target date and a separately collected preceding date. Preserve every original strict failure; this is not a replacement acceptance gate or snapshot activation.

rules.volume: Shares/100 must round half-up to the archived whole-lot value.
rules.amount: Difference strictly below CNY 1; keep missing original fields unknown.
rules.pct: Derive 100*(close/preclose-1) from Decimal prices. Compare to the primary reported percent at its two-decimal precision, at most 0.005 percentage points.
rules.change: Decimal close minus preclose; compare at most 1e-7.
rules.turnover: Test overlap of rounding intervals: primary two decimals +/-0.005 percentage points and observed source stock four decimals +/-0.00005 (ETF six +/-0.0000005). This is a compatibility test, not proof of the underlying float denominator or rounding algorithm.
rules.source_pct_consistency: Reported source pctChg should differ from the exact price-derived percent by at most 0.00005 percentage points.

data_selection: Every security in the fixed universe present in the full source response; no symbol exceptions selected from returns.
